title: Technical English — Course 5, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 7

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the email demonstration take place?
tasks.audioText: The procurement engineer will demonstrate a technical clarification email on Thursday at nine thirty. Students should bring the supplier specification and the component drawing. The demonstration will show how to state a part reference, describe a discrepancy and ask a precise question. The instructor will also explain why attachments should be named clearly and referenced in the message.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which drawing and supplier document are needed for the clarification email?
tasks.audioText: The procurement engineer will demonstrate a technical clarification email on Thursday at nine thirty. Students should bring the supplier specification and the component drawing. The demonstration will show how to state a part reference, describe a discrepancy and ask a precise question. The instructor will also explain why attachments should be named clearly and referenced in the message.
options: The supplier specification and component drawing

tasks.prompt: A procurement engineer noticed that a supplier specification listed a different connector type from the one shown on the approved drawing. The engineer sent a concise email with the part reference, the relevant drawing revision and a marked extract. The message asked the supplier to confirm the connector type before the order was processed. It did not assume that either document was incorrect. Reading 1. What discrepancy did the engineer notice?
options: The connector type differed between the supplier specification and approved drawing

tasks.prompt: Why did the message include the drawing revision?
options: To identify the exact drawing version being discussed

tasks.prompt: The supplier ___ to confirm the connector type before the order was processed.
Choose TWO features of a useful technical clarification email.
options: A conclusion that has not been checked

tasks.prompt: A difference between two records or values is a ___.
You need a supplier to confirm a discrepancy. Which request is most appropriate?
options: Your specification is wrong. Change it.
Could you confirm which connector type applies to part reference X, using the attached drawing revision?
Send a new document without explanation.
I will assume the drawing is correct.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of supplier technical correspondence in a logical order.
options: Attach and reference the relevant evidence
Identify the part and document revision
Ask the supplier for a clear confirmation
correctOrder: Identify the part and document revision
Attach and reference the relevant evidence
Ask the supplier for a clear confirmation

tasks.prompt: Write 100–120 words as a formal technical email asking a supplier to clarify a discrepancy between a specification and a drawing.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); precise technical vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
